note: Example company for a fork. Northwind Goods is fictional. Every person named here is synthesized.

data_sensitivity.question: Will this vendor touch {company_name} customer data, yes or no?

_comments.company_name: Your company's name. The daily digest prints this. Northwind Goods is fictional; replace it.
_comments.demo: true only for the shipped Acme demo in config/company.json. A fork sets false.
_comments.note: One line on who this file is for. Do not put customer data or secrets here.
_comments.people_label: Keep [SYNTHESIZED] while the names below are examples. Real approvers use their own names.
_comments.stale_after_hours: Hours a waiting approver sits in silence before a nudge. Silence is never an approval. This sample uses 48.
_comments.always_route: Role names that approve every vendor. manager belongs here.
_comments.approvers: One string per role, shaped Name [SYNTHESIZED], Title. Keys must match always_route and data_sensitivity.security_role. The record_approval --name value is this whole string.
_comments.approver_emails: Optional address per role for the email notice. The sample uses example.com placeholders. Replace them before turning email on. Unused while email is off.
_comments.data_sensitivity.security_role: Role added when the intake field or the pack flag says the vendor would hold customer or personal data.
_comments.data_sensitivity.intake_field: Intake field that answers the customer-data question. Leave touches_customer_data unless you change the intake check.
_comments.data_sensitivity.pack_check_flag: Pack check key for the same question. The shipped packs use r3_shows_personal_data.
_comments.data_sensitivity.legacy_pack_flags: Older pack keys to treat as that flag. Empty for a new company. The Acme demo file lists one old key.
_comments.data_sensitivity.question: Asked when the intake field is missing. {company_name} is replaced with company_name.
_comments._comments: Notes for the person filling this file. Scripts ignore this key. The file is ordinary JSON: copy it, no code changes.
